definitions.overall: Original strict question_id top1/top5 over the entire unchanged seeded sample
definitions.reason: A middle-stem excerpt shared by multiple questions cannot identify one question_id; count containment in full text, not equal middle excerpts
definitions.timing: Mean query latency includes query encoding; initial model/matrix setup is separate; measured timing varies between runs
definitions.unique: Query occurs in exactly one corpus question's full text (including options and passage); strict question_id top1/top5
definitions.unresolved: Zero containing texts are listed separately, never silently dropped from overall metrics; empty-group metrics and unrun acceptance gates are null
